name: Blackened Flame
descriptionTemplate: At turn start, apply {Burn} to 1 Command Card in hand and gain 1 stack of {Blackened Flame}. When {Blackened Flame} reaches 3 stacks, put 1 {Endless Combustion} into hand.
lore: The pitch-black flames will execute her will, burning everything to ashes.
